in_marathi.name: Niyanvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Descendant of a brave and wise king
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niyanvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Niyanvansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words niyan, meaning 'wise', and vansh, meaning 'lineage' or 'descendants'. This name signifies a brave and wise ruler, a king who governs with wisdom and courage.
